content: Primary HTTP and Google Search Central guidance supports conditional retrieval via ETag/If-None-Match or Last-Modified/If-Modified-Since and treats sitemaps as discovery hints, not guaranteed crawl inventories. Scrapling documents robots rules, crawl delays and sitemap spiders. Recommendation: MVP manual recrawl plus atomic generation publish; later add sitemap-first discovery and unchanged-page skipping only with durable per-URL validators/fingerprints and deletion semantics.
